name: ambiguous
description: Vague 'make it production ready' request: clarification, assumptions, mid-run change request and re-plan
requirement: Make the URL shortener production ready. It should be fast and secure, and we are seeing abuse from bots.

answers.AMB-SEC: Throttle abusive clients and add standard browser security headers.

requirements_signoff.comment: Assumptions AMB-PROD and AMB-ABUSE accepted (30 creates/min/client).

design_signoff.comment: New 429 / 422 failure modes are acceptable to API clients.

events.text: Also reject links whose destination is a known phishing domain (blocklist).
events.reason: Phishing campaign reported while implementation was in flight
